List a store's datasets or a DuckDB connection's tables

Source: R/duckdb.R
store_tables.Rd

For a store: store_datasets() plus the column duckdb_view, the name of the view store_duckdb() gives each dataset (NA for rasters, which have none). For a DuckDB connection: its tables and views outside the schemas information_schema, pg_catalog and rcs, with the dataset and version of the views made by store_duckdb().

Usage

store_tables(x, st = NULL)

Arguments

x

A store connection made by store_connect(), or a DuckDB connection.

st

NULL, or, with a DuckDB connection, the store connection to compare the views' versions with.

Value

A tibble. For a store, see store_datasets(). For a connection, one row per table or view, sorted: schema, name, type ("table" or "view"), dataset and version (NA for objects not made by store_duckdb()), and with st a column current: TRUE when the view shows the version in st's catalog, FALSE when not (call store_duckdb() again), NA for other objects.

See also

store_duckdb(), store_datasets().

Examples

root <- file.path(tempdir(), "rcs-example-tables")
st <- store_connect(root, create = TRUE)
store_write(st, rcs_sim_table(100, seed = 1), "sales/daily",
  title = "Daily sales", description = "Simulated daily sales."
)
#> ℹ Writing "sales/daily": 100 rows in 1 file.
#> ✔ primary  /tmp/Rtmp/rcs-example-tables  1/1
#>   files sent  13.7 kB  0.2s
#> ✔ MD5 identical for 1 file in 1 location. Catalogs updated.
store_tables(st)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>   dataset  kind  title  rows bytes n_files partition version updated            
#>   <chr>    <chr> <chr> <dbl> <dbl>   <int> <list>    <chr>   <dttm>             
#> 1 sales/d… table Dail…   100 13733       1 <chr [0]> 9eda87… 2026-11-22 10:52:31
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: duckdb_view <chr>
con <- store_duckdb(st)
#> ✔ DuckDB view (native mode, nothing read yet): `sales.daily`.
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "mine", data.frame(a = 1:3))
store_tables(con, st)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   schema name  type  dataset     version          current
#> * <chr>  <chr> <chr> <chr>       <chr>            <lgl>  
#> 1 main   mine  table NA          NA               NA     
#> 2 sales  daily view  sales/daily 9eda87d6a9e1e320 TRUE   
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
unlink(root, recursive = TRUE)
